title: Merchant Onboarding Application
description: Merchant Onboarding Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-merchant-onboarding-application
  title: Merchant Onboarding Application
  description: Merchant Onboarding Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_merchant_onboarding_application_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/merchant_onboarding_application
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/merchant_onboarding_application
    sourceVersion: fs_merchant_onboarding_application_v1
    sourceDigest: 5840f45cc820be07618be7a6e2b93cc8d8a51ed6c9d7f2da11b4ba9fda2ec288
spec:
  role: start
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Merchant Onboarding Application
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: application-date
              name: application_date
              label: Application Date
              description: Date the merchant application was submitted.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: reserve-terms
              name: reserve_terms
              label: Reserve Terms
              description: Reserve amount, percentage, or duration.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: merchant-category-code
              name: merchant_category_code
              label: Merchant Category Code
              description: MCC if stated.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: business-type
              name: business_type
              label: Business Type
              description: Retail, ecommerce, restaurant, marketplace, services, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: website-url
              name: website_url
              label: Website Url
              description: Merchant website or app URL.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: processing-channels
              name: processing_channels
              label: Processing Channels
              description: Card-present, ecommerce, mobile, keyed, ACH, or other channels.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: estimated-monthly-volume
              name: estimated_monthly_volume
              label: Estimated Monthly Volume
              description: Estimated monthly processing volume.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
            - id: chargeback-history
              name: chargeback_history
              label: Chargeback History
              description: Prior chargeback history or ratio.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: underwriting-decision
              name: underwriting_decision
              label: Underwriting Decision
              description: Approved, declined, conditional, pending, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: merchant-tax-id-masked
              name: merchant_tax_id_masked
              label: Merchant Tax Id Masked
              description: Masked EIN or tax identifier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: average-ticket-amount
              name: average_ticket_amount
              label: Average Ticket Amount
              description: Average transaction amount.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: high-ticket-amount
              name: high_ticket_amount
              label: High Ticket Amount
              description: Highest expected transaction amount.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: reserve-required
              name: reserve_required
              label: Reserve Required
              description: Whether reserve or holdback is required.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: merchant-legal-name
              name: merchant_legal_name
              label: Merchant Legal Name
              description: Merchant legal entity name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: merchant-dba-name
              name: merchant_dba_name
              label: Merchant Dba Name
              description: Doing-business-as name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: beneficial-owner-names
              name: beneficial_owner_names
              label: Beneficial Owner Names
              description: Beneficial owners listed in application.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: principal-signer-name
              name: principal_signer_name
              label: Principal Signer Name
              description: Principal or authorized signer.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: refund-policy
              name: refund_policy
              label: Refund Policy
              description: Refund, cancellation, or return policy summary.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: risk-rating
              name: risk_rating
              label: Risk Rating
              description: Merchant risk rating.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: approval-conditions
              name: approval_conditions
              label: Approval Conditions
              description: Underwriting conditions.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
  validationRules:
    - id: merchant-legal-name-present
      severity: error
      description: merchant_legal_name is required for Merchant Onboarding Application extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: merchant_legal_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: merchant_legal_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: merchant_legal_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(merchant_legal_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: estimated-monthly-volume-present
      severity: error
      description: estimated_monthly_volume is required for Merchant Onboarding Application extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: estimated_monthly_volume
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: estimated_monthly_volume
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: estimated_monthly_volume IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(estimated_monthly_volume)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: estimated-monthly-volume-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: estimated_monthly_volume should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: estimated_monthly_volume
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: estimated_monthly_volume
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: estimated_monthly_volume IS NULL OR estimated_monthly_volume >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: average-ticket-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: average_ticket_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: average_ticket_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: average_ticket_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: average_ticket_amount IS NULL OR average_ticket_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: high-ticket-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: high_ticket_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: high_ticket_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: high_ticket_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: high_ticket_amount IS NULL OR high_ticket_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      merchant_legal_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Merchant Onboarding Application workflow.
      merchant_tax_id_masked:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Merchant Onboarding Application workflow.
      estimated_monthly_volume:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Merchant Onboarding Application workflow.
      underwriting_decision:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Merchant Onboarding Application workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Merchant Onboarding Application documents combine structured fields and narrative
      risk/legal/compliance context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      application_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the merchant application was submitted.
        format: date
      merchant_legal_name:
        type: string
        description: Merchant legal entity name.
      merchant_dba_name:
        type: string
        description: Doing-business-as name.
      merchant_tax_id_masked:
        type: string
        description: Masked EIN or tax identifier.
      merchant_category_code:
        type: string
        description: MCC if stated.
      business_type:
        type: string
        description: Retail, ecommerce, restaurant, marketplace, services, or other.
      website_url:
        type: string
        description: Merchant website or app URL.
      processing_channels:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Card-present, ecommerce, mobile, keyed, ACH, or other channels.
      estimated_monthly_volume:
        type: number
        description: Estimated monthly processing volume.
      average_ticket_amount:
        type: number
        description: Average transaction amount.
      high_ticket_amount:
        type: number
        description: Highest expected transaction amount.
      refund_policy:
        type: string
        description: Refund, cancellation, or return policy summary.
      chargeback_history:
        type: string
        description: Prior chargeback history or ratio.
      reserve_required:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether reserve or holdback is required.
      reserve_terms:
        type: string
        description: Reserve amount, percentage, or duration.
      beneficial_owner_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Beneficial owners listed in application.
      principal_signer_name:
        type: string
        description: Principal or authorized signer.
      risk_rating:
        type: string
        description: Merchant risk rating.
      underwriting_decision:
        type: string
        description: Approved, declined, conditional, pending, or other.
      approval_conditions:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Underwriting conditions.
    required:
      - merchant_legal_name
      - estimated_monthly_volume
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - merchant_legal_name
            - estimated_monthly_volume
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
